label: Restaurant Hospitality
visual_principles: Make the food, menu, hours, and location easy to act on.
Use atmosphere and menu structure instead of generic service cards.
Keep reservation, order, or visit CTAs close to visual content.

imagery.priority: food, interior, storefront, menu items, hospitality moments

cta_rules: Use view menu, reserve, order, or visit language.
Show hours and location before the footer when available.
Do not invent menu items or prices.
